summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Sladkiygramm 3.6 iteration 3 completed successfully. All major iteration 3 features tested and verified working. Key updates tested: $ removed from nickname display, darker theme colors (Space=purple, Sunset=pink, Dark=blue, Light=indigo), Privacy & Terms modal with full text, FAB menu with New Contact and New Group options, smart prefix search implementation, delete confirmation modal code verified, group creation modal functional. 100% success rate on all tested features.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warnings: useNativeDriver not supported (expected), props.pointerEvents deprecated - non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: ✓ $ sign removal implemented via cleanNick function - removes $ prefix from display throughout app
✓ Theme colors updated to darker/more pleasant tones (Space: purple #a855f7, Sunset: pink #f472b6, Dark: blue #3b82f6, Light: indigo #6366f1)
✓ Privacy & Terms modal implemented with full legal text in both EN and RU
✓ Delete confirmation modal implemented with 'Are you sure?' prompt before deletion
✓ FAB menu properly shows both 'New Contact' and 'New Group' options when clicked
✓ Smart prefix search implemented using .startsWith() for user nickname matching
✓ Context menu has all required options: Pin, Mute, Archive, Delete for me, Delete for everyone
✓ Group creation modal functional with group name input and member selection
✓ Profile displays nickname without $ sign (cleanNick applied)
✓ Animated secret code with pulse animation, glow effect, and tap-to-reveal functionality
✓ All 4 themes display with gradient buttons and proper color schemes
✓ Group management functions present: kickMember, transferOwnership, changeGroupName
All testID attributes properly implemented on interactive elements
React Native components used correctly throughout
Liquid glass UI styling maintained across all screens
